articles.title: More major teams and key markets commit to becoming EuroLeague franchises
articles.standfirst: Receives more than a dozen binding offers from teams to become franchises that will generate more than 700 million and 3.2 billion in infrastructure investments
articles.summary: Receives more than a dozen binding offers from teams to become franchises that will generate more than 700 million and 3.2 billion in infrastructure investments
articles.body:
The EuroLeague Board held this morning in Barcelona, which was attended by all the representatives of the competition’s shareholder teams , announced with great fanfare its unstoppable expansion plan with which it is on course to monopolize European basketball, taking a considerable lead over the NBA Europe project, whose launch is initially scheduled for the 2027-28 season.

The EuroLeague CEO, Chus Bueno , revealed in full detail the receipt of more than a dozen binding offers , with commitments already signed, from teams and investors who have demonstrated through duly signed documents their desire to become EuroLeague franchises starting from the 2027-28 season , in which the tournament will probably change format and be divided into two Conferences , in light of the growing number of teams.

These binding offers guarantee the competition revenues of more than 700 million euros by adding the fee—of varying amounts depending on their significance in the continental basketball market—that all the new partners will have to pay, binding contracts from several teams and cities including Valencia Basket, Dubai Basketball, PAOK Thessaloniki, Paris Basketball, Hapoel Tel Aviv, Partizan, and Red Star.

Consolidates and protects the seven major markets

In addition, it adds new highly strategic cities such as London, Rome and Naples to its unstoppable expansion, through which the EuroLeague manages to consolidate and protect the seven most important markets in European basketball: Turkey, Greece, Italy, Spain, Germany, France and Great Britain . In this way, it expands its borders, gains ground throughout European basketball and reinforces its dominance.

All these teams and cities demonstrate through their binding offers that they are fully committed to and excited about this project , as evidenced by the fact that, in addition to contributing more than 700 million euros among them as a fee, they will invest more than 3.2 billion euros in infrastructure .

They have already passed the first "due diligence"

All these new teams and investors have already passed the first "due diligence" by the Euroleague Board , an investigation, review, and verification process to confirm that they have the capacity and are sufficiently solvent and competitive to become franchises in the competition. Although final approval will be given by the Board of Owners or Owners' Assembly , which will take place at the end of this coming September and from which the new franchises whose proposals are accepted will emerge.

Chus Bueno , who took the reins of the EuroLeague as its new CEO on January 30, 2026, and his executive team have managed in just eight months to keep the EuroLeague project moving forward in giant strides with its ambitious expansion plan that seems to have no ceiling , achieving exponential growth from both a quantitative and qualitative standpoint that allows it to consolidate its dominance in the European basketball market .

Long-term partnership agreements

“ The EuroLeague is experiencing strong momentum , both commercially and strategically, with major renewals of long-term partnership agreements agreed in recent weeks and the launch of new events that continue to expand our platform,” Bueno explained.

The interest sparked by the franchise process clearly reflects the confidence that clubs, investors, and new projects place in the future of the EuroLeague

The EuroLeague CEO also highlighted the consolidation of the project: "At the same time, the interest sparked by the franchise process clearly reflects the confidence that clubs, investors, and new projects place in the future of the EuroLeague. The binding offers, close to 700 million euros , which represent a total investment of more than 3.2 billion euros over the next five years, demonstrate the strength of our business model and the value generated throughout the League".

Money advanced by the clubs... for the clubs

An investment by the clubs that will benefit them entirely, not the organization. The EuroLeague has required all those investors to commit in writing to the money that is going to be advanced by the clubs for the clubs themselves. And that is the premise that best and most strongly stimulates the commitment and enthusiasm of all of them to back a competition of which the clubs themselves will be the only beneficiaries.

articles.title: Taurian Fontenette Cause of Death: How did iconic basketballer die aged 43?
articles.standfirst: Fontenette was also known as Air Up There and Mr. 720 and became a global sensation
articles.summary: Fontenette was also known as Air Up There and Mr. 720 and became a global sensation
articles.body:
Taurian Fontenette , known to basketball fans as Air Up There and Mr. 720 , the streetball phenomenon whose extraordinary dunking ability made him one of the most recognizable figures of the AND1 era, has died at 43 after he helped redefine what was possible above the rim. Fontenette died Monday night, November 2, with his sister, Tracie Sonnier , announcing the news the following day. No cause of death had been publicly disclosed, leaving family, friends and basketball fans mourning the sudden loss.

Sonnier shared an emotional tribute on Facebook , describing her brother as a remarkable person whose personality and passion for basketball left a lasting impression on everyone around him. “My heart is broken in a million pieces,” Sonnier posted. “I honestly don’t even have the words to express the tremendous pain of losing my baby brother. This is a loss that I don’t think our family will ever fully understand or be able to put into words. Thank you all for giving us grace, and allowing our family to try and process this and gain some understanding about what has happened. You were a true gift, a one-of-a-kind soul, and someone whose presence could light up any room. "A basketball genius with a love and talent for the game that was unmatched, the life of every party, and a person with a heart so big that you never hesitated to go the extra mile for anyone who needed you. “You had a way of making people laugh, making memories, and leaving an impression that could never be forgotten. Your energy, your laughter, your generosity, and that beautiful spirit of yours will forever live in the hearts of everyone blessed enough to know you. "I wish I had more time. More conversations, more laughs, more memories, and just one more opportunity to tell you how much you mean to me.”

How Fontenette became Mr. 720: Taurian’s legacy after his death

Born in 1983, Fontenette grew up in Hitchcock, Texas , where he developed into an outstanding basketball prospect as despite standing approximately 6-foot-2, he regularly stood out against bigger opponents through his explosive leaping ability. He earned three consecutive all-state selections at Hitchcock High School between 1998 and 2000, averaging around 20 points and 12 rebounds during his final three varsity seasons. His performances earned him a scholarship to play for the UTEP Miners , although he later continued his career at junior colleges, including Richland and Paul Quinn . After stepping away from college basketball , Fontenette worked security at a chemical plant but his life changed when the AND1 Mixtape Tour arrived in Houston in 2005 and he successfully auditioned for a place on the roster. “I’m not really a streetball player,” Fontenette told the Houston Chronicle in 2006. “I’m more of a gym rat-type of player, but it’s been cool.” His defining moment arrived during the 2006 tour at the Houston Rockets ' Toyota Center , where he completed what is widely recognized as the first documented in-game 720-degree dunk, as spinning twice in mid-air before finishing at the basket, he produced a spectacular moment that earned him the Mr. 720 nickname. The dunk reached a worldwide audience after appearing on ESPN's SportsCenter , while his Axle-Rider, a 360-degree between-the-legs dunk, further established his reputation as an innovative performer. Fontenette later appeared on the Ball4Real and BallUp tours before attempting to enter organized professional basketball with the Dallas Generals in the ABA in 2009, but the team folded before the season began, but his influence on streetball and dunking culture remained.

articles.title: Cavaliers and Knicks watch as a baby steals the spotlight with a convincing victory
articles.standfirst: The game in Cleveland had an unexpected star, who won a crawling race and created a memorable moment when an arena host brought over a microphone.
articles.summary: The game in Cleveland had an unexpected star, who won a crawling race and created a memorable moment when an arena host brought over a microphone.
articles.body:
Last Saturday, November 7, the Cleveland Cavaliers welcomed the New York Knicks to Rocket Arena. The visiting team came away with a 109-97 victory, but a little star managed to steal some of the attention without scoring a single point . During one of the game's halftime activities, a baby won a crawling race and ended up creating a moment nobody saw coming.

The challenge was simple: several babies had to make their way across the court, where their parents were waiting with toys and other objects to encourage them. Everyone wanted to be the first to reach the finish line, but Electric Emerson was the one who got there ahead of the competition .

And if her victory had already won over the crowd, what happened next was even better. The arena host approached her with a microphone for a quick interview, but the little girl seemed to have other plans . As soon as he brought it close, she grabbed it and tried to put it in her mouth, as if she wanted to find out for herself what that strange object was.

Jalen Brunson and Donovan Mitchell headline the action on the court

While Electric Emerson was stealing the show with her unexpected interview, the Knicks and Cavaliers were battling it out on the court in a matchup that delivered plenty of standout performances of its own. Jalen Brunson led the way for New York with 31 points and nine assists . The point guard was particularly impressive in the second quarter, when he scored 18 consecutive points and helped the Knicks take control of the game.

Karl-Anthony Towns also had a big afternoon, finishing with 29 points and 13 rebounds . New York made the most of its presence inside the paint, collecting 16 offensive rebounds and creating additional scoring opportunities while making things difficult for Cleveland.

On the other side, Donovan Mitchell did everything he could to keep the home team in the game. The shooting guard finished with 37 points, including 21 in the fourth quarter, as he tried to bring the Cavaliers back in the closing minutes .
